description: This is a WebSocket connection management module for real-time sports live updates, handling connections, disconnections, message broadcasting, and user-specific messaging.

classes.name: ConnectionManager
classes.description: Manages WebSocket connections, including connecting, disconnecting, message broadcasting, and user-specific messaging for real-time updates.

methods.name: __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes data structures to store connections and metadata.

methods.name: connect(self, websocket: WebSocket, event_id: str, user_id: str = None)
methods.description: Accepts a WebSocket connection, registers it under an event and optional user, and sends a welcome message.

methods.name: disconnect(self, websocket: WebSocket)
methods.description: Removes a WebSocket connection and cleans up associated metadata.

methods.name: send_personal_message(self, message: Dict[str, Any], websocket: WebSocket)
methods.description: Sends a JSON message to a specific WebSocket.

methods.name: broadcast_to_event(self, message: Dict[str, Any], event_id: str)
methods.description: Broadcasts a message to all connections associated with a specific event.

methods.name: broadcast_emoji_reaction(self, event_id: str, emoji_data: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Broadcasts an emoji reaction update to all connections for an event.

methods.name: broadcast_match_update(self, event_id: str, match_data: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Broadcasts match data update to all connections for an event.

methods.name: send_to_user(self, user_id: str, message: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Sends a message to a specific user identified by user ID.

methods.name: int get_connection_count(self, event_id: str)
methods.description: Returns the number of active WebSocket connections for a specific event.

methods.name: int get_total_connections(self)
methods.description: Returns the total number of active WebSocket connections across all events.

methods.name: List[str] get_active_events(self)
methods.description: Returns a list of event IDs with active WebSocket connections.
